name: Brand
definition: Nominal typing for a validated primitive.

name: Result
definition: Accepted value or named refusal; the only way a context reports a refusal.

name: Accepted
definition: The accepted half of a Result.

name: Refused
definition: The refused half of a Result, carrying the refusal.

name: NonEmptyArray
definition: A readonly list with at least one item.

name: RelativePath
definition: A forward-slash path below a root that cannot escape it.

name: ContentHash
definition: sha256 of a file's bytes, written sha256:<hex>.

name: FrameworkVersion
definition: An AI-DLC release version, stable or preview.

name: DistributionId
definition: The id of one harness distribution (claude, kiro-ide, codex...); open set, registered once.

name: Timestamp
definition: A UTC ISO-8601 instant.

name: KernelRefusal
definition: Why a kernel value was refused.

name: StageSlug
definition: Identity of a Stage; kebab-case and equal to its file stem.

name: ScopeName
definition: Identity of a Scope; one shell-safe word.

name: AgentSlug
definition: Identity of an Agent persona.

name: ArtifactName
definition: Identity of an artifact in the method's vocabulary.

name: SensorId
definition: Identity of a SensorDeclaration.

name: PluginId
definition: Identity of a plugin; never in core's aidlc- namespace.

name: Owner
definition: Whether a method item belongs to core or to a named plugin.

name: IdentityRefusal
definition: Why a method identity was refused.

name: Phase
definition: One of initialization, ideation, inception, construction, operation.

name: UnitKind
definition: What a Unit of work is (service, spec, ui, packaging, library); prunes per-unit artifacts.

name: Tier
definition: How much judgment an agent's work needs: judgment, balanced, templated.

name: ReviewClass
definition: How a review runs: none, advisory, adversarial.

name: GuardPolicy
definition: How far the switchable guards stand aside: strict, relaxed, off.

name: CeremonyKey
definition: A per-work ceremony a scope can switch: sensors, learnings, summary confirmation, plan approval, collaborators.

name: CeremonySwitch
definition: On or off, as the person says it.

name: CeremonyDefaults
definition: The ceremony switches a scope sets; unset ones stay on.

name: Depth
definition: How deep a scope runs: minimal, standard, comprehensive.

name: ProjectType
definition: Brownfield or greenfield.

name: CollaborationMode
definition: Who talks to whom while a stage runs: inline, subagent, pipeline, mob, agent-team.

name: EnsembleMode
definition: A CollaborationMode that needs support agents: pipeline or mob.

name: SoloCapableMode
definition: A CollaborationMode that can run with the lead alone.

name: AgentRef
definition: A stage lead: the conductor itself or a named Agent.

name: Participation
definition: A stage's lead, supports and mode; ensemble modes require supports by type.

name: StageExecution
definition: Whether a stage always runs or runs on its stated condition.

name: StageCardinality
definition: Whether a stage runs once or once per Unit.

name: ArtifactProduction
definition: An artifact a stage writes, required or optional, for which unit kinds.

name: ArtifactConsumption
definition: An artifact a stage reads, whether required, when, and whether its deliverables cite it.

name: ReviewPolicy
definition: A stage's reviewer, reviewed artifact, iteration cap and declared class.

name: SummaryConfirmation
definition: Whether a stage owes the person a consolidated-summary confirmation.

name: StageActivation
definition: A structured predicate that switches a stage on (producer-in-plan).

name: ComposerTarget
definition: An outcome component the composer screens a stage for.

name: ComposerRole
definition: A stage's structural role in composer screening.

name: ComposerPrior
definition: The composer's screening prior for a stage: targets, cost, role, project types.

name: StageBriefing
definition: A stage's stated inputs, outputs and instructions.

name: Stage
definition: One station of the method: what it produces and consumes, who works it, how it is reviewed.

name: ToolPolicy
definition: Which host tools an agent may not use.

name: Agent
definition: A persona that works stations: identity, tier, tools and persona text.

name: Scope
definition: A production line: depth, Guard Policy, ceremony and review defaults; membership comes from stages.

name: RuleLayer
definition: Where a rule sits: org, team, project or a phase.

name: RulePairing
definition: Whether a rule is checked by a sensor, feedforward only, or unpaired.

name: Rule
definition: Method guidance at one layer, with its pairing and staleness.

name: SensorSeverity
definition: Advisory or blocking.

name: SensorTrigger
definition: When a sensor fires: on write or at the gate.

name: SensorFieldShapes
definition: Declared input or output fields of a sensor and their shapes.

name: SensorDeclaration
definition: A deterministic check a stage can pull in: command, severity, trigger, path filter.

name: KnowledgeAudience
definition: Whether a knowledge document is shared or for one agent.

name: KnowledgeDocument
definition: Team or method knowledge an agent brings to its station.

name: OverlayFragment
definition: Text a plugin inserts at a named anchor, in order.

name: StageAdditions
definition: Artifacts and sections a plugin adds to an existing stage.

name: OverlayTarget
definition: The core stage or agent a plugin overlay amends.

name: Overlay
definition: A plugin's additive amendment to a core stage or agent.

name: ContributionDependency
definition: What a plugin needs present: core or another plugin.

name: Contribution
definition: Everything one plugin adds to the method: content plus overlays.

name: MethodContent
definition: The stages, scopes, agents, rules, sensors and knowledge of a method or contribution.

name: PluginSelection
definition: Which installed plugins an install has switched on.

name: Method
definition: The compiled method: core plus selected contributions, with its StageGraph. The aggregate.

name: StageNumber
definition: A stage's compiled display number, <phase>.<index>.

name: StageNode
definition: A stage's place in the compiled graph: number, enabled, rules in context, active sensors.

name: ScopeColumn
definition: The stages one scope executes.

name: StageGraph
definition: The compiled order of stages and the scope grid.

name: DefinitionConcept
definition: Which method concept a MethodRefusal is about.

name: MethodRefusal
definition: Why authored content or a contribution cannot join the method.

name: MethodReading
definition: The async result of reading authored method content.

name: AuthoredSourceReader
definition: Port: reads core's authored files into MethodContent, parsing each file with Zod.

name: ContributionSource
definition: Port: reads every installed plugin's Contribution.

name: PluginSelectionSource
definition: Port: reads which plugins this install has switched on.

name: CompileMethodRequest
definition: Core content, contributions and selection to compile.

name: CompileMethod
definition: Use case: compiles content and contributions into a Method or refuses with reasons.

name: LoadMethod
definition: Use case: reads sources and compiles the Method.

name: EnvironmentMark
definition: An environment variable (optionally with a value) a host sets in its agent's shell.

name: HostShell
definition: The marks that say a command runs in this host's shell.

name: HostSpecificLine
definition: A line said only when the given host marks are present.

name: FirstRunGuidance
definition: What the person does after setup, in the host's words.

name: CliFirstGuidance
definition: First-run guidance for a host's CLI when it is the one on PATH.

name: HookRegistrationRepair
definition: Where a host reads hook registrations, and what to say when they are missing, invalid or unwired.

name: HookActivation
definition: What to say and do when the host's hooks are not running.

name: StatusLineSetting
definition: The host's status line setting that shows AI-DLC progress.

name: NewChatStep
definition: How the person starts a clean chat in this host.

name: HarnessProfile
definition: A harness's typed runtime capabilities and wording, shipped with its payload.

name: Sharing
definition: Whether a root file is exclusive, a union of harnesses, or identical across them.

name: LegacySignatures
definition: Hashes of earlier releases' root content that installation may adopt.

name: RootIntegration
definition: A project-root file a harness shares with the person and the policy for merging it.

name: RootIntegrationPolicy
definition: managed-block, whole-file, json-map, json-array, jsonc-settings or json-entries.

name: FileContent
definition: A file's text or bytes.

name: RenderedConcept
definition: Which method or harness concept a rendered file came from.

name: ProjectionOrigin
definition: Where a projected file came from: neutral source, harness-authored, or rendered.

name: Availability
definition: Whether a projected file ships always, only by copy, or only natively.

name: ProjectedFile
definition: One harness-correct file with its origin.

name: HookPoint
definition: A host lifecycle point a hook is registered at.

name: HookEntry
definition: One runtime hook to register and where.

name: NeutralDocument
definition: A harness-neutral source document placed into a harness tree.

name: SessionSkill
definition: A read-only session skill shipped to every harness.

name: OnboardingTemplates
definition: The neutral onboarding text and the per-harness skeleton.

name: NeutralSurface
definition: Everything harness-neutral a projection needs besides the Method.

name: ProjectionFinding
definition: An advisory fact found while projecting.

name: ProjectionRefusal
definition: Why a projection cannot be produced.

name: Projection
definition: The aggregate: every harness-correct file, root integration and the profile for one harness.

name: Rendering
definition: Files a Harness rendered, or why it could not.

name: NeutralDocumentRole
definition: What a neutral document is, so the Harness knows where it lands.

name: Harness
definition: Port: one adapter per harness, owning every harness-specific rendering. The only place harness differences live.

name: HarnessRegistry
definition: Port: the registered Harness adapters, found by DistributionId.

name: NeutralSurfaceReader
definition: Port: reads the NeutralSurface from core.

name: ProjectMethodRequest
definition: Which harness, which Method, which surface.

name: ProjectMethodForHarness
definition: Use case: projects a Method into one harness's files.

name: Layout
definition: How a payload ships: copy (runtime as source) or native (runtime as binary).

name: RuntimeEntryPoint
definition: A runtime composition root the payload bundles.

name: PayloadFileOrigin
definition: Whether a payload file was projected, bundled runtime, the version stamp or the descriptor.

name: PayloadFile
definition: One shipped file with its hash and origin.

name: VersionStamp
definition: Which release, distribution and harness directory a payload is.

name: RetiredFile
definition: A file earlier releases shipped that this one does not, with the bytes they shipped.

name: DistributionDescriptor
definition: What an installer needs to know about a payload: profile, root integrations, managed and retired files.

name: Payload
definition: The aggregate: one distribution's shippable files in one layout at one version.

name: ArchiveFormat
definition: tar.gz or zip.

name: ReleaseArtifact
definition: A written release archive and its digest.

name: PackagingRefusal
definition: Why a payload or artifact cannot be produced.

name: ToolBundler
definition: Port: bundles runtime entry points into payload files for a layout.

name: ArtifactWriter
definition: Port: writes payloads into a release archive.

name: ContentHasher
definition: Port: hashes file content.

name: PackagePayloadRequest
definition: Projection, layout, version, runtime and retired files to package.

name: PackagePayload
definition: Use case: turns a Projection into a Payload.

name: BuildReleaseArtifact
definition: Use case: writes payloads into a ReleaseArtifact.

name: InstalledFile
definition: A file AI-DLC wrote into the project and the hash it wrote.

name: EntryHashes
definition: Entries AI-DLC owns inside a shared file, by key, with the hash it wrote.

name: RootContribution
definition: What AI-DLC put into one shared root file, per policy.

name: McpChoice
definition: Whether the install ships the default MCP servers.

name: OwnershipRecord
definition: The project's record of everything AI-DLC owns (aidlc-manifest.json).

name: InstallMode
definition: Fresh install, refresh (optionally forced) or removal.

name: ManagedFileDecision
definition: What happens to one file: create, update, unchanged, preserve, conflict or retire.

name: RootIntegrationDecision
definition: What happens to one shared root file.

name: InstallNote
definition: One line the person reads about the plan.

name: InstallPlan
definition: The immutable aggregate: every decision for one payload in one project, and the record after.

name: InstalledDistribution
definition: A distribution installed in this project, with its stamp and profile.

name: EnvironmentSnapshot
definition: The environment a command runs in, read once.

name: CallingHarness
definition: Which installed distribution this command runs for: sole, marked by host shell, guessed, or none.

name: InstallRefusal
definition: Why an install or refresh cannot go ahead, with what to do.

name: ProjectFileState
definition: What is at a project path now: absent, file, link or directory.

name: ExpectedState
definition: What a file operation expects to find before it acts.

name: FileOperation
definition: One write, remove or link inside a transaction.

name: ProjectFiles
definition: Port: reads project file state.

name: OwnershipStore
definition: Port: reads the OwnershipRecord, parsing it with Zod.

name: Transaction
definition: Port: applies file operations all-or-nothing.

name: InstalledDistributions
definition: Port: lists distributions installed in the project.

name: PayloadSource
definition: Port: fetches the payload to install.

name: EnvironmentReader
definition: Port: snapshots the environment.

name: PlanInstallRequest
definition: Payload and mode to plan.

name: PlanInstall
definition: Use case: compares a payload with the project and its record into an InstallPlan.

name: ApplyInstallPlan
definition: Use case: applies a plan through the Transaction or refuses.

name: ResolveCallingHarness
definition: Use case: works out the CallingHarness.

name: IntentId
definition: Identity of one piece of work (an intent) and its WorkflowRecord.

name: IntentSlug
definition: The readable label of an intent.

name: SpaceName
definition: A named space of intents and team memory under aidlc/.

name: SessionId
definition: Identity of one host chat.

name: UnitName
definition: Identity of a Unit of work; a safe path component.

name: CheckoutId
definition: Identity of a git checkout that can hold Units.

name: AuditEventName
definition: A name from the audit event catalogue.

name: PlanFingerprint
definition: The fingerprint of an approved plan; binds an approval to what was approved.

name: RecordVersion
definition: Optimistic version of a WorkflowRecord.

name: Unit
definition: A Unit of work in this intent, its kind and dependencies.

name: UnitDag
definition: The Units and the batches Construction walks.

name: UnitHolder
definition: Which checkout holds a Unit, by claim.

name: CheckpointKind
definition: Unit or skeleton checkpoint.

name: Checkpoint
definition: Where a finished Unit's stages are verified and approved together.

name: BlockingCheckSite
definition: Where a blocking check stands: a stage gate or a Unit checkpoint.

name: BlockingCheckOutcome
definition: Passed, failed, or overridden by the person.

name: BlockingCheck
definition: A blocking sensor's result at its site.

name: Gate
definition: A point where the person decides: stage gate, plan approval or checkpoint.

name: GateDecision
definition: Approve, request changes, skip, jump or stop.

name: HumanEvidenceSource
definition: How a human turn was observed: host hook or host transcript.

name: HumanEvidence
definition: An observed turn the person typed; a fact, separate from what Guard Policy makes it mean.

name: Approval
definition: A recorded decision at a gate, with its evidence and fingerprint.

name: ReviewAttempt
definition: One requested review of a stage's artifact.

name: ReviewFindingStatus
definition: Open, resolved, rejected or reopened.

name: ReviewFinding
definition: One reviewer finding.

name: ReviewReceipt
definition: A reviewer's verdict and findings for an attempt.

name: GuardId
definition: The one named rule behind a stop.

name: SwitchableGuardId
definition: A guard the person can switch off for a piece of work.

name: GuardLift
definition: How the person lifts a guard: switch, one-off override, or locked by prior judgement.

name: Guard
definition: One named stop: what it protects and how the person lifts it.

name: GuardRefusal
definition: A guard's stop: reason, next step and lift.

name: GuardSwitch
definition: A recorded switch of a guard, with the person's words.

name: StageProgress
definition: pending, in-progress, awaiting-approval, revising, completed or skipped.

name: StageState
definition: A stage's progress in this intent, per Unit when per-unit.

name: WorkflowStatus
definition: Running, parked, completed or archived.

name: WorkflowSettings
definition: This intent's depth, Guard Policy, ceremony switches and review override.

name: WorkflowRecord
definition: The aggregate: everything recorded about one intent.

name: TransitionCause
definition: Whether the engine or a person's decision moved the work.

name: Transition
definition: A recorded move: stage progress, park, resume, reopen or complete.

name: Reopen
definition: The Transition that takes finished work back to running when the person asks.

name: SessionBindingSource
definition: How a chat came to be on a piece of work.

name: SessionBinding
definition: Which space and intent a chat is on.

name: Session
definition: One chat on this clone, with its binding.

name: AuditEvent
definition: One appended audit row: name, intent, session, time, fields.

name: HostEvent
definition: Something the host reported: session start/end, human turn, tool request, subagent finish, turn end.

name: HostEventVerdict
definition: Allow, or block with a reason and next step.

name: ArtifactDestination
definition: Where a stage's artifact is written for this run.

name: QuestionOption
definition: One option put to the person, in plain words.

name: Directive
definition: What the engine tells the conductor to do next.

name: ExecutionRefusal
definition: Why the engine cannot act: a guard, or the record.

name: RecordStore
definition: Port: loads and saves WorkflowRecords with optimistic versions.

name: AuditLog
definition: Port: appends and reads AuditEvents.

name: Clock
definition: Port: the current Timestamp.

name: HostEvents
definition: Port: human turns the host recorded since a time.

name: Sessions
definition: Port: the current chat.

name: UnitClaims
definition: Port: reads and makes Unit claims.

name: MethodProvider
definition: Port: the compiled Method this install runs.

name: HostConversation
definition: The host wording the engine needs, translated from HarnessProfile at the composition root.

name: HostConversationSource
definition: Port: the HostConversation for this command.

name: NextStep
definition: Use case: the next Directive for an intent.

name: DecideAtGate
definition: Use case: records the person's decision at a gate.

name: ObserveHostEvent
definition: Use case: records a host event and answers allow or block.

name: ReopenWorkflow
definition: Use case: reopens finished work on the person's word.

name: DecodeRefusal
definition: Why a host payload could not be decoded.

name: HostEventDecoder
definition: Port: one adapter per host turning its hook payload into a HostEvent.

name: ExitStatus
definition: A command's exit status.

name: CommandRoute
definition: Port: one CLI verb routed to one use case.
